# BBC

> > BBC is a comprehensive digital news and media platform delivering breaking news, live sports coverage, documentaries, podcasts, and entertainment content to global audiences.

BBC.com serves as the primary digital hub for the British Broadcasting Corporation, offering real-time news coverage across politics, world events, sports, business, technology, health, culture, and travel. The platform features live streaming capabilities, award-winning video journalism, documentaries, radio broadcasts, and podcasts alongside traditional news reporting.

## Key Topics

## News & Live Coverage

- [BBC Home](https://www.bbc.com/home): BBC homepage with news, sports, weather, TV & radio highlights across BBC Online
- [BBC News](https://www.bbc.com/news): BBC News hub with breaking news, world coverage, Iran conflict, and multimedia content
- [BBC Live & Breaking News](https://www.bbc.com/live): BBC Live coverage with breaking news, sports, football, and live journalism
- [BBC News Channel - Watch Live](https://www.bbc.com/watch-live-news): Live BBC News Channel with 24/7 breaking news coverage from around the world
- [US & Canada News](https://www.bbc.com/news/us-canada): US and Canada news hub with breaking updates, politics, Iran conflict coverage
- [UK News](https://www.bbc.com/news/uk): UK news hub with breaking news, regional updates, and national headlines
- [Politics](https://www.bbc.com/news/politics): UK politics coverage with Labour government, elections, and policy updates
- [England Regional News](https://www.bbc.com/news/england): England regional news with local stories, crime, health, and community coverage

## Sports

- [BBC Sport](https://www.bbc.com/sport): BBC Sport with live scores, Premier League, football, cricket, and multi-sport coverage

## Business, Technology & Innovation

- [BBC Business](https://www.bbc.com/business): BBC Business covering economy, tech, AI, Elon Musk, Twitter, and market updates
- [BBC Technology](https://www.bbc.com/technology): BBC Technology hub covering AI, innovation, consumer tech, gaming, and gadgets
- [BBC Future Planet](https://www.bbc.com/future-planet): BBC Earth covering climate, environment, wildlife, Planet Earth, and sustainability

## Lifestyle & Wellbeing

- [BBC Health](https://www.bbc.com/health): BBC Health exploring nutrition, fitness, mental health, sleep, and wellness topics
- [BBC Travel](https://www.bbc.com/travel): BBC Travel with destinations, food & drink, celebrity travel guides, and experiences

## Entertainment & Culture

- [BBC Culture](https://www.bbc.com/culture): BBC Culture with entertainment news, film reviews, music, BTS, and arts coverage
- [BBC Arts](https://www.bbc.com/arts): BBC Arts hub featuring theatre, opera, visual arts, La Sagrada Familia, and dance

## Video, Audio & Documentaries

- [BBC Video](https://www.bbc.com/video): BBC Video hub with award-winning video journalism and global feature stories
- [BBC Audio & Podcasts](https://www.bbc.com/audio): BBC Audio hub with live radio, podcasts, You're Dead to Me, and audio content
- [BBC Documentaries](https://www.bbc.com/video/docs): BBC Documentaries including history, nature, true crime, and royal history series

## Optional

- [BBC Home](https://www.bbc.com): BBC homepage with breaking news, world news, sports, business, and entertainment
